messages.author: 794570edb1de2b89
messages.subject: Shiny app failed in server
parts:
I am trying to debug a Shiny app that is not working in my server. Unfortunately the only error I get is the following:

An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification.

I configured my server to keep the logs (preserve_logs true;) but the logs are empty. This seems to be due to a 500 HTTP error but I have no insight on what is happening with the shiny server? How do I even start to debug this issue?

messages.author: 794570edb1de2b89
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app failed in server
parts:
Found what was the issue. Apparently my Shiny Server is sanitizing errors even though I did not setup the app or the server to sanitize errors. I modified my server to NOT sanitize errors by adding the following parameter to the config file.

sanitize_errors false;

After this it was easy to determine what was happening with my app.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app failed in server
parts: Sorry, we haven't properly publicized the fact that Shiny Server's new default behavior is to sanitize errors in the UI. However, the log files are supposed to contain the original error message regardless of the sanitize_errors setting--if not, that's certainly something we need to investigate.
